correctness.rationale: Linearity of indicators gives E[F1(m)]=sum_i a_i*C(N-a_i,m-1)/C(N,m). For a->a-1, b->b+1, the numerator difference polynomial is (1+z)^(N-a) Q(z), Q=(1+z)^d(1-bz)+(a-1)z-1, d=a-b-1>=1. Its coefficient q1=2d>0, q_{d+1}=-b<0 and ratios C(d,j)/C(d,j-1)=(d-j+1)/j strictly decrease, giving one + to - coefficient sign change; multiplication by (1+z) through adjacent sums is variation diminishing. Terminal and initial coefficients persist, proving exactly one switch for all N. Separately, independently written exact integer-partition enumeration for every 2<=N<=17, every same-length ordered strict-majorization pair and all m returned comparison counts (0,0,1,2,7,13,30,55,106,182,336,551,947,1543,2549,4032), total 10,354, no multi-reversal N<=16, and exactly N=17 pair (9,4,3,1) ≻ (7,6,2,2) with numerator (0,14,108,350,597,522,129,-112,9,114,-70,-306,-325,-186,-63,-12,-1), three sign reversals. Partition recursion is complete over positive integer profiles, making this a finite exhaustive proof within the specified class; it proves nothing for larger N or non-majorization comparisons.
